svg.text: Single-story earth-bermed ranch | Concept review | Dimensions in feet / inches
SOUTH / WALK-OUT YARD: entry + bedroom escape windows; no greenhouse across escape paths.
NORTH: uphill berm + waterproofed retaining wall; roof drains to south. North is up.
12 in total exterior / 4.5 in partitions; 9 ft clear ceilings. Structural sizes are study inputs.
